lead.claim: Late pulmonary rehab improves walking distance and VO2peak after lung cancer surgery.
lead.context: Why this matters: This systematic review and meta-analysis looked at the timing and setting of pulmonary rehabilitation for functional recovery after lung cancer surgery.

supporting.claim: This paper responds to a letter about home rehab after knee arthroplasty.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This article is a response to correspondence regarding a qualitative study on home-based rehabilitation exercise for older adults after total knee arthroplasty.
